### 🟠 `AS-013` — Tool Shadowing

**Severity:** High

**Description:**
tool name "airquality" duplicates "air_quality" already registered in this tool set — a malicious server can shadow a trusted tool by registering an identical name

**Recommendation:**
Two or more tools registered in your MCP environment share an identical or near-identical name. A malicious server can shadow a trusted tool this way, intercepting calls you intend for the legitimate tool. Remove the conflicting server or rename its tools to be unambiguous.

### 🟠 `AS-013` — Tool Shadowing

**Severity:** High

**Description:**
tool name "station_info" duplicates "stationinfo" already registered in this tool set — a malicious server can shadow a trusted tool by registering an identical name

**Recommendation:**
Two or more tools registered in your MCP environment share an identical or near-identical name. A malicious server can shadow a trusted tool this way, intercepting calls you intend for the legitimate tool. Remove the conflicting server or rename its tools to be unambiguous.
